grammar.title: Asking and saying the date: 今天(是)幾月幾日
grammar.pattern: 今天／昨天／明天 ＋（是）＋ ＿月＿日（號）
grammar.explanation: Chinese dates go from big to small: month first, then the day. To ask, put 幾 in the slot you don't know: 幾月幾日. The answer just fills those slots in: 六月三日. 是 is often kept in the full sentence (今天是六月三日) but can be dropped in speech (今天六月三日). Time words like 今天、昨天 sit at the front of the sentence, not after the verb.
grammar.contrast: 日 vs 號: they mean the same thing, but 日 is the written/formal form you see on forms, signs and in the news, while 號 is what people actually say out loud in Taiwan (今天幾月幾號?). Which one you pick depends on writing vs speaking, not on meaning. Also note dates always take 幾, never 多少.
grammar.common_error: Learners copy the English order and say things like 三日六月 for 'the 3rd of June'. In Chinese the month must come first: 六月三日. A second common slip is using 多少 ('how many') to ask the date — 今天多少月? is wrong; it has to be 今天幾月幾日/號?

passage.title: 我的週末
passage.hanzi: 昨天是十月九日，星期六。早上天氣很好，我騎腳踏車十分鐘，在學校附近的早餐店吃早餐。老闆認識我，他說：「今天是你的生日嗎？」我說：「不是，我的生日是十月十日。」下午我和朋友搭捷運逛書店，晚上在夜市吃臭豆腐。現在十一點半了，明天我們再一起逛逛。
passage.gloss: Yesterday was October 9th, a Saturday. The weather was lovely in the morning, so I rode my bike for ten minutes and had breakfast at the breakfast shop near my school. The owner knows me, and he asked, "Is today your birthday?" I said, "No, my birthday is October 10th." In the afternoon my friend and I took the MRT and browsed a bookstore, and in the evening we ate stinky tofu at the night market. It's half past eleven now; tomorrow we'll go out walking around together again.

grammar.title: V + 了 for a completed action
grammar.explanation: Put 了 right after the verb to say the action is already finished. The time word (上午, 中午, 昨天晚上) goes before the verb, not after. If the object has a number, 了 stays between the verb and the object: 我吃了一個便當. With a simple object or no object, 了 can sit at the end: 他回家了。
grammar.contrast: 了 (already done) vs 要 (going to do). 今天上午我做了作業 = it's finished; 今天上午我要做作業 = it hasn't happened yet. The time word alone does not tell you — 了 or 要 does.
grammar.common_error: Learners say 我沒吃了飯. When you negate with 沒, you must drop 了: 我沒吃飯。Also avoid putting the time word after the verb (吃了中午 is wrong; say 中午吃了).

passage.title: 我的週末上午
passage.hanzi: 週末上午,我七點半就起來了,騎腳踏車去附近的早餐店,買了一個包子和一杯紅茶。回家我看了一本新書。中午太熱了,我沒去外面吃,在家做了麵。吃飽了,我就回房間睡覺。睡了一個鐘頭,下午我要搭捷運去逛書店,晚上十一點半睡覺。
passage.gloss: On weekend mornings I got up at 7:30, rode my bike to the breakfast shop nearby, and bought a steamed bun and a cup of black tea. Back home, I read a new book. At noon it was too hot, so I didn't go out to eat — I made noodles at home. After I was full, I went back to my room to sleep. I slept for an hour; in the afternoon I'm taking the MRT to browse a bookstore, and I'll go to bed at 11:30 at night.
